player.name: DC Parkin
player.placeOfDeath: Sangster's Farm, (Eagle's Crag) Albany, Cape Province

items.html:
A medium-pace bowler, Dante Parkin played one Test against England at Cape Town in 1891-92. He also toured England in 1894 but struggled to come to terms with turf pitches.
Martin Williamson

match.title: Only Test
match.statusText: England won by an innings and 189 runs
